div.div: Green: goes through Azure Firewall or the WAF. Dotted blue: temporary, during the migration. Red: controlled by an NSG or by IoT Hub, without the firewall. DNS between Cali and the hub resolver is also controlled by NSG (UDP and TCP 53). Traffic between the centers and Cali during coexistence (FW-401 and FW-402) goes through the firewall.
